hoi4modernutils.featureFlags.title: Feature Flags
hoi4modernutils.featureFlags.desc: Feature flags are used to disable or enable features. Reloading is required after changing this. Please refer to Wiki on Github for details.
hoi4modernutils.installPath.title: Install Path
hoi4modernutils.installPath.desc: Hearts of Iron IV install path. If you are on web, you should press Ctrl+Shift+P, and type "Select HOI4 Install Path" command instead of this setting.
hoi4modernutils.loadDlcContents.title: Load DLC Contents
hoi4modernutils.loadDlcContents.desc: Whether to load DLC images when previewing files. Enabling this will use more memory.
hoi4modernutils.modFile.title: Working Mod File
hoi4modernutils.modFile.desc: Path to the working .mod file. This file is used to read replace_path. If not specified, will use first .mod file in first folder of the workspace.
hoi4modernutils.preview.title: Preview HOI4 file
hoi4modernutils.previewworld.title: Preview World Map
hoi4modernutils.scanreferences.title: Scan References
hoi4modernutils.scanAndLogErrors.title: Scan for World Map Errors and Write Log
hoi4modernutils.selecthoifolder.title: Select HOI4 Install Path
hoi4modernutils.selecthoifolder.desc: Heart of Iron IV install path.
hoi4modernutils.selectmodfile.title: Select Mod File
hoi4modernutils.enableSupplyArea.title: Enable Supply Area
hoi4modernutils.enableSupplyArea.desc: If you are developing a mod for HOI4 (version <= 1.10), enable this to show supply areas.
hoi4modernutils.previewLocalisation.desc: Language of content in previews. This setting takes effect only when localisation indexing is enabled.
hoi4modernutils.indexing.title: Indexing
hoi4modernutils.indexing.desc: When indexing is enabled, you don't need to manually add dependency to your .txt files when they use content from other files. Indexing takes start up time and more memory.
hoi4modernutils.stateBoundaryColor.title: State Boundary Color
hoi4modernutils.stateBoundaryColor.desc: CSS color for state boundary lines in province view (e.g. 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)', '#FF0000').
hoi4modernutils.stateBoundaryWidth.title: State Boundary Width
hoi4modernutils.stateBoundaryWidth.desc: Line width multiplier for state boundary lines in province view (default: 1.5).
hoi4modernutils.worldMapSelectionUndoKey: Keybind used in world map preview for selection-only undo. Examples: T, Ctrl+Z, Alt+U.
hoi4modernutils.worldMapSelectionRedoKey: Keybind used in world map preview for selection-only redo. Examples: R, Ctrl+Y, Alt+I.
hoi4modernutils.worldMapMapUndoKeybind.d: Keybind used in world map preview for map edit undo fallback. Example: Ctrl+Z.
hoi4modernutils.worldMapMapRedoKeybind.d: Keybind used in world map preview for map edit redo fallback. Example: Ctrl+Y.
hoi4modernutils.worldMapCreateStateKeybi: Keybind used in world map preview to create state from selected provinces. Example: Ctrl+Shift+N.
hoi4modernutils.worldMapAssignSelectionK: Keybind used in world map preview to assign selected provinces to the selected state. Example: Ctrl+Enter.
hoi4modernutils.worldMapAssignSelectionT: World Map Assign To Strategic Region Keybind
Keybind used in world map preview to assign selected states to the selected strategic region. Example: Ctrl+Shift+G.
hoi4modernutils.worldMapConfirmNewProvin: World Map Confirm New Province Creation

Show a confirmation dialog before creating a new province in the world map preview's paintbrush tool. Disabling this (e.g. via the dialog's "Don't ask again" checkbox) skips the confirmation; re-enable it here.
